<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — The CSS mirrors the assign-form fix (full-width grid, wrapping labels) and should remove the overflow. No screenshot or scrollWidth measurement is part of this change.
- A2: unverified — No screenshot is attached, and a 36px height floor isn't enforced in the rule. The selected-state styling isn't touched.
- A3: unverified — The rules are scoped to max-width: 640px, so 768px and 1280px should be unaffected. No before or after screenshots are attached.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- 36px minimum button height isn't guaranteed by the rule `src/app/cloud/console.css:2592` — Add `min-height: 36px;` to `.compare-controls .seg > *`.

</details>

suggestions.title: 36px minimum button height isn't guaranteed by the rule
suggestions.detail: The padding is var(--s-2) with line-height 1.2. A single-line label may come out under 36px unless .seg buttons already set a min-height or height. Only a screenshot can confirm this. The diff doesn't set a floor, and A2 requires one.
suggestions.repro: Measure button height at 375px with an unwrapped label, e.g. "Peak", and compare it to 36px.
